source: California Regional Water Quality Control Board, Central Valley Region (R5) — Nonpoint Source Unit
obtained: 2026-07 (Public Records Act response, analyst Courtney Kasich)
area: Dixie Fire burn scar, Greenville watershed, Plumas County
finding: The watershed is monitored for post-fire recovery, but NOT for any of the herbicides applied in it. No pesticide/herbicide analyte appears in the sampling panel.

stations.location: Setzer Camp Creek / Greenville-Wolf Creek Roads

notified_but_not_tested: USFS formally notifies the Water Board of herbicide operations (e.g. Wildcat project: aminopyralid <7 oz/acre + Competitor surfactant, backpack/hand spray, June-Sept, per a 2023 notice) and herbicide/reforestation work is tracked for BMP compliance — but the water is not screened for these compounds.
